country: # Not web-verified: well-known spots from general knowledge
region: pinned with OSM kite / beach features.

name: Varberg – Apelviken
notes: Sweden's best-known surf bay: waves in SW–W winds, rocks at the edges. Kite zone; keep clear of surfers and bathers.

name: Mellbystrand
notes: Very long, shallow sand beach on Laholmsbukten; flat to small waves, good for learning. Summer bathing zones.

name: Skanör
notes: Shallow sandbars off Falsterbonäset, flat to choppy; all levels. Seal and bird protection areas on the reefs.

name: Kämpinge
notes: Shallow sandy bay on the Baltic side of Höllviken, flat water close in; good for learning.

name: Lomma
notes: Shallow beach on Lommabukten, flat to choppy; popular with Malmö kiters. Kite zone outside the bathing area.

name: Malmö – Ribersborg
notes: City beach, shallow and flat for a long way out; summer bathing zones.

name: Öland – Böda
notes: Long sand beach on Böda bay, northern Öland; shallow, flat to small waves in easterlies.

name: Gotland – Tofta
notes: Long sand beach south of Visby, shallow; flat to small waves in westerlies.
